packageRules.description: ESLint 10 requires Node.js >=20.19, but unit tests still run on Node.js 18 to cover the published packages' supported engines. Keep eslint and @eslint/js aligned on v9 until migrating to ESLint 10
eslint-import-resolver-node 0.3.10 and later use resolve 2.x, which no longer resolves relative imports when the directory of the linted file does not exist
picomatch 3 and later change how Windows paths are detected and matched. Keep picomatch and its types on v2, which behaves like micromatch 4, until the upgrade is reviewed
